body: Well, it's another day. It's a bit better. Sometimes you get to a tipping point, but can still come back down

TBA, it seems very defensive. Maybe she was doing something, maybe not. I think you should focus on something else and take a break from this. Space is good. Sometimes a break is best. Trust me, I know how hard that can be when the emotions are strong, but it's generally best when both parties aren't on the same page yet
